info.title: Segmentation
info.description:
[Download API specification](https://developer.salesforce.com/static/commercecloud/commerce-api/inventory-segmentation/segmentation-oas-v1-public.yaml)

# API Overview

Dynamic Inventory Segmentation enables merchants to define criteria-driven inventory quotas that allocate a SKU's Available-to-Order across selling channels. By creating segment criteria scoped to `(SKU, location, group)` combinations, merchants can reserve capacity for specific groups, ensuring balanced allocation and preventing any single channel from exhausting shared inventory.

## Key Capabilities

- **Segment Criteria Management** — Create, retrieve, update, delete, activate, and deactivate quota criteria. Criteria define percentage-based or quantity-max allocations with configurable priority.
- **Batch Operations** — Submit up to 100 criteria in a single transaction with all-or-nothing atomicity.
- **Validation** — Dry-run criteria against the segmentation engine to catch conflicts before committing.
- **Audit Visibility** — Inspect how quotas were allocated for a given SKU across locations and groups, including the criteria that sourced each segment.
- **Epoch Advancement** — Trigger mint-and-rebalance operations to recalculate quotas based on updated criteria.

## Authentication and Authorization

Inventory Segmentation uses dedicated OAuth2 scopes:
- Write operations: `sfcc.inventory.segmentation.rw`, `sfcc_inventory_segmentation_rw`
- Read operations: `sfcc.inventory.segmentation`, `sfcc_inventory_segmentation`

## Response Details

All error responses follow the [RFC 7807](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7807) problem detail format. Include a `correlation-id` header in requests to trace errors via the returned `x-correlation-id`.

Inventory Segmentation uses the Tenant Group ID in place of the Organization ID, consistent with other Omnichannel Inventory services. For configuration details, see [Configuration Values](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/guide/commerce-api-configuration-values).

delete.description: Delete a segment criteria. Deletion is asynchronous: the criteria is hidden immediately (a subsequent GET /criteria/{segmentCriteriaId} returns 404), then the segments it sourced are removed and the affected quotas re-minted from the remaining criteria. The 200 response returns a segmentCriteriaDeletionId and a statusLink; poll the statusLink to track progress to completion.

parameters.description: The unique identifier for a segment criteria.

200.description: Deletion accepted. The criteria is hidden immediately; poll the statusLink to track progress to completion.

GroupId.description: An identifier for a collection of locations.

Tag.description: A customer-defined tag label applied to a SKU. Restricted to letters, digits, underscore, and hyphen because the tag name is placed directly in a URL path segment.

SegmentCriteriaId.description: Unique identifier for a segment criteria. Server-generated.

CriteriaType.description: The type of a segment criteria. Quota-minting types (percentage, quantity_max) set the allocated quota. Import-basis types (in_epoch_import_basis, out_of_epoch_import_basis) configure how an import re-mints a quota. The epoch-phase type (epoch_window_minutes) configures the in-epoch window duration.

CriteriaValue.description:
Interpreted according to the sibling `criteriaType` field, always encoded as a string:

- `percentage`: a numeric string decimal between 0.0 and 1.0 (e.g. `"0.25"` = 25%).
- `quantity_max`: a numeric string, non-negative integer-valued quantity.
- `epoch_window_minutes`: a numeric string, positive integer number of minutes.
- `in_epoch_import_basis` / `out_of_epoch_import_basis`: either `"whole_value"` or `"delta_only"`.

SegmentCriteriaResponse.description: A segment criteria as returned by the service. Optional fields are omitted from the response when they have no value.

createdTime.description: The ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this criteria was created.

lastUpdatedTime.description: The ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this criteria was last updated.

lastMintedTime.description: The ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this criteria last minted a quota. Absent if it has never minted one.

SegmentCriteriaListResponse.description: Paginated list of segment criteria. Returned by GET /criteria and POST /criteria/batch.

message.example: An invalid request parameter was provided.

parameterName.description: When invalid json is passed to the service, this field will indicate which piece of the supplied json was invalid.

entity.description: When the error refers to a specific resource that was not found, this field carries the entity-type label (for example "SegmentCriteria" or "EpochAdvance"). Present on EntityNotFound responses; absent otherwise.

entityId.description: When the error refers to a specific resource that was not found, this field carries the identifier the customer supplied for that resource. Present on EntityNotFound responses; absent otherwise.

SegmentCriteriaCommand.description: Command body for creating, updating, or previewing a segment criteria. At least one of targetGroupId, sourceLocationId, sku, or tag must be non-null — except for criteriaType epoch_window_minutes, which permits all of them being null (a single all-wildcards criterion configures a tenant-wide default window). The service enforces this constraint and returns 400 when it is violated. Additionally, sku and tag are mutually exclusive; supplying both returns 400.

targetGroupId.description: The group to which this quota applies. Optional; at least one of targetGroupId, sourceLocationId, sku, or tag must be non-null.

OperationStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of an asynchronous operation.

Non-terminal values:
  - STAGING   : the request has been accepted and persisted, but processing has not yet been enqueued. Normally observed only briefly.
  - WAITING   : processing is waiting on a precondition before it can be enqueued (e.g. a required input).
  - SUBMITTED : the operation has been enqueued but processing has not yet begun.
  - PENDING   : processing has been acknowledged but has not yet reported execution status.
  - RUNNING   : the operation is actively processing records.

Terminal values:
  - COMPLETED : the operation ran to completion.
  - FAILED    : the operation aborted before completion (e.g. an infrastructure failure). Details are surfaced in errors.
  - STOPPED   : the operation was halted by the service before completion. Customers do not initiate this transition.
  - EXPIRED   : the operation's waiting precondition elapsed before it could run.

OperationStatusResponse.description: Status and result details for an asynchronous operation. Returned by the epoch-advance status and segment-criteria-deletion status endpoints. Counter fields are populated as processing progresses; an operation that has been accepted but not yet started returns zero-valued counters rather than an error.

startTimeUTC.description: The ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when processing started. Absent until the operation starts.

endTimeUTC.description: The ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the operation reached a terminal state. Absent while it is non-terminal.
